meta.title: VIS — AI-Powered Content Creation and Publishing
meta.description: VIS is an AI-powered platform that helps creators, businesses and organizations create, manage and publish digital content across multiple social media platforms.
meta.keywords: VIS, Viral Intelligence System, AI content platform, social media publishing, content management, OAuth publishing

hero.title: Create, manage and publish content
hero.description: VIS is an AI-powered platform that helps creators, businesses and organizations create, manage and publish digital content across multiple social media platforms.

platform.title: One workspace for modern digital content operations
platform.description: VIS supports structured content workflows from preparation and management to authorized publication and later performance analysis.
platform.creationText: Prepare digital content using AI-assisted processes while keeping control over the final material.
platform.managementText: Organize publishing-ready materials, platform-specific text and media assets in consistent workflows.
platform.publishingText: Publish only to accounts that their owners have voluntarily connected through official platform authorization.

capabilities.title: Built for creators, businesses and authorized account management
capabilities.description: VIS can be used by individual creators, organizations and agencies working on behalf of client accounts that have granted the required permissions.
capabilities.multiPlatformText: Prepare and manage content for multiple supported social media platforms without exposing passwords or bypassing platform rules.
capabilities.responsibleText: VIS is designed to automate repetitive content operations while preserving account ownership, user authorization and platform requirements.
responsibleItems: No password collection from social platforms
No guaranteed views, reach or income claims
No use for spam or deceptive activity

security.title: Accounts remain under the control of their owners
security.description: VIS uses official OAuth authorization mechanisms provided by supported social platforms. Access is limited to permissions approved by the account owner.

items.title: No social password storage
items.text: VIS does not request or store account passwords for connected social media services.

items.title: Permission-based access
items.text: Functions are performed only within scopes approved during OAuth authorization.

items.title: Encrypted token storage
items.text: OAuth tokens used by VIS are stored in encrypted form.

items.title: Revocable connections
items.text: Account owners can revoke platform access or request disconnection and deletion of related data.

security.noticeText: VIS does not sell personal data and does not promise guaranteed views, reach, followers, revenue or platform approval.

policies.title: Clear policies for users, clients and connected accounts
policies.description: Review how VIS processes authorized account data and the conditions that apply to use of the service.

contact.title: Questions about VIS or connected account data?
contact.description: Contact the VIS team for service, privacy or account disconnection requests.

footer.description: VIS is an AI-powered platform for creating, managing and publishing digital content through authorized social media connections.
